notes: Hard. The agent must author a single deterministic multi-command tool /app/clean.py and run it against shipped /app/data to emit /app/result.json and /app/top.tsv (dependent_stages=3: write tool -> run org transform -> run top-k transform). tool_breadth=3 because seven distinct transform contracts must each be implemented and honored (nested JSON graph with strict nesting/sorted-key/no-duplicate cardinality, entity-name-or-account filter, top-k frequency ranking, boolean-column-detected grouped aggregations, per-invoice total-with-fallback plus conflict reconciliation, hourly linear-interpolation with boundary fallback, exactly-2-field JSON Lines). quantitative_correctness=3: every aggregate, count, interpolated value, and top-k count is compared exactly with tolerance; ordering (sorted dept keys, asc-url tie-break, preserved record order, every hourly step) is strict. hidden_case_generalization=3: the verifier re-invokes /app/clean.py on four fresh scenarios with edge inputs (dedup of duplicate names, dept with zero staff, orphan project rows, case-insensitive entity match plus account-only match, non-matching companies, missing tax -> null, missing due -> paid fallback, total-vs-due conflict, leading/trailing hourly gaps with boundary fallback and interior interpolation, empty cells, exactly-two-field JSONL). adversarial_inputs=2 (ties, dupes, gaps, mixed boolean tokens 0/1/yes/no). The hard floor comes from the nested multi-CSV org-graph competency (unique dept ids, min cardinality, sorted-by-key) which is the max competency floor.
